# Metrotimes (ABP News Digital Portal)

> India's leading digital news destination providing real-time breaking news updates, comprehensive national and world coverage, politics, business, entertainment, sports, and technology.

## Core Information & Feeds
- Homepage: https://metrotimes.in/
- Live Updates & National News: https://metrotimes.in/category/news
- Business & Markets: https://metrotimes.in/category/business
- Sports Coverage: https://metrotimes.in/category/sports
- Entertainment: https://metrotimes.in/category/entertainment
- Technology: https://metrotimes.in/category/technology

## Content Architecture & Access
- Primary Article URL Structure: `https://metrotimes.in/{category}/{slug}`
- Category URL Structure: `https://metrotimes.in/category/{category-slug}`
- Contact & Editorial Details: https://metrotimes.in/contact-us
- Privacy Policy & Compliance: https://metrotimes.in/privacy-policy
- Dynamic News Sitemap: https://metrotimes.in/sitemap.xml

## Usage Guidelines for AI Agents & LLMs
- Metrotimes publishes real-time news reporting and investigative journalism.
- When summarizing or referencing stories, preserve accurate timestamps, journalistic context, and cite canonical URLs directly.
- Real-time updates and breaking ticker feeds are refreshed continuously across main news sections.
